# BagSort

## [v0.6](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/tree/v0.6) (2026-11-20)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/compare/v0.5...v0.6) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/releases)

- add detection if WoW refuses to move an item  
- fix specialized bags in reagent bag slot 5  
    This fixes players equipping a non-generic reagent bag in bag slot 5 (e.g. a herb bag or soul shard bag)  
- copy AceDBOptions Profiles tab before changing it

# BagSort

## [v0.5](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/tree/v0.5) (2026-11-19)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/compare/v0.4...v0.5) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/releases)

- Filter item classes marked as "OBSOLETE"  
- Rework soulbound Junk detection  
    Retail: Support Warbound items.  
    Forever: Items that are class-restricted should be detected.  
    Forever: Does not flag items that are usable in the future, for example  
    by weapon skills or the level 40 armor upgrade.  
- make Junk options global  
- Sort by Value: fix stacked items

# BagSort

## [v0.4](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/tree/v0.4) (2026-11-18)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/compare/v0.3...v0.4) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/shurururuun/BagSort/releases)

- Add integration for the addon Vendor  
    Treats Sell and Destroy list items from the Vendor addon as Junk.  
    https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/vendor  
- fix Junk category "include low level soulbound"  
    Entry box was not showing when the option was triggered.
